history.summary: A very large 2,519 sqft 4BR at $2.75M in The Warren, D23 Choa Chu Kang, 330m from Choa Chu Kang MRT/LRT interchange (JS1 — Jurong Region Line). Clean resale-only 4.73%/yr on a healthy 89 txns and a $1,092 PSF ~8% under median, but the low PSF is heavily a size effect and the $2.75M OCR quantum is steep for the location.
history.rating_rationale: Mixed. Strengths: 330m to Choa Chu Kang interchange now on the Jurong Region Line (JRL ~2028 catalyst), reliable 4.73% resale CAGR on a solid 89-txn sample, and PSF ~8% below median. But the headline-cheap $1,092 PSF is an illusion of size — at 2,519 sqft this is an enormous unit, and the $2.75M quantum is very high for OCR Choa Chu Kang, where buyers at that price point are scarce (HDB-upgrader budgets cap out well below). A 2004 leasehold (~78yrs left) compounds the exit problem. The JRL is a real positive and a genuine family would value the space, but for investment the $2.75M-in-OCR exit risk dominates.
red_flags: $2.75M quantum is very high for OCR Choa Chu Kang — thin local buyer pool at that price
Low $1,092 PSF is a size illusion (2,519 sqft); per-dollar value not as cheap as it looks
2004 leasehold (~78yrs remaining) — lease decay over a 5-7yr hold
catalysts: 330m to Choa Chu Kang interchange — Jurong Region Line (JRL ~2028) uplift
Reliable 4.73% resale CAGR on 89 txns; PSF ~8% below median
